cmd:
echo '--- manual test of the exact cron string ---'
bash -c 'S=$(date +%s); sleep 2; E=$(date +%s); echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] main duration: $((E-S))s" >> /var/log/vps-durations.log'
cat /var/log/vps-durations.log
echo '--- crontab raw bytes check (od) ---'
crontab -l | grep durations | od -c | head -5
echo '--- syslog cron errors ---'
grep -i cron /var/log/syslog 2>/dev/null | tail -20
